title: Relation-Conditioned Cross-Engine Transport Boundary, Replicated QSearch-Negative Law Mediation, Minor-Material Divergence Localization, Inanis Channel-Factorized Admission & Cross-Architecture Counterexample Design
scientific_question: Why does HEAVY_HEAVY transport the CURVED/QSEARCH-negative fingerprint across Stockfish19, Berserk and Ethereal while MINOR_MINOR changes dominant coordinate/sign across the same admitted engine families?

discovery_confirmation_split.P21: prospective test of frozen mediation rivals on disjoint fresh worlds; no P20 outcome may alter P21 thresholds after this seal

EXPOSURE_ONLY.claim: Cross-engine transport/nontransport is explained by pre-intervention persistent-memory engagement exposure alone.
EXPOSURE_ONLY.test: Select fresh cells using SHAM telemetry only, construct exposure-balanced strata, then test whether HEAVY_HEAVY vs MINOR_MINOR transport contrast survives.
EXPOSURE_ONLY.defeat: Transport contrast survives within the presealed exposure-balanced design.

TT_QSEARCH_SEMANTIC.claim: HEAVY_HEAVY replication is specifically a qsearch transposition-table semantic-read law within admitted MAIN/QSEARCH-TT engines.
TT_QSEARCH_SEMANTIC.test: Fresh Stockfish19/Berserk/Ethereal qsearch/main interventions under identical exact-world selection plus Inanis structural-zero counterexample.
TT_QSEARCH_SEMANTIC.support: HEAVY_HEAVY QSEARCH-negative fingerprint prospectively replicates in the three TT-qsearch engines while Inanis cannot instantiate QSEARCH×SEARCH_TT by construction.

BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY.claim: The transportable object is broader than TT: qsearch consumption of persistent semantic memory is sufficient.
BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY.test: Native-Rust Inanis QSEARCH×PAWN_EVAL_CACHE is separately admitted, then tested on a seven-piece pawn-carrier lane where its payload is nontrivial.
BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY.support: An independently admitted qsearch pawn-evaluation-cache intervention shows the presealed HEAVY_HEAVY negative qsearch-memory direction on pawn-carrier worlds.
BROADER_QSEARCH_PERSISTENT_MEMORY.defeat: Channel is admitted and engaged but does not reproduce the direction.

ENGINE_LOCAL_SEMANTIC_POLICY.claim: MINOR_MINOR divergence reflects engine-specific semantic use rather than mere hit exposure.
ENGINE_LOCAL_SEMANTIC_POLICY.test: After exposure-balanced selection and per-engine susceptibility normalization, dominant-coordinate/sign divergence remains.
ENGINE_LOCAL_SEMANTIC_POLICY.support: Divergence survives the frozen normalization/matching analysis.

PAWNLESS_CORE.purpose: direct P20 relation-boundary confirmation under disjoint fresh exact worlds

PAWN_CARRIER.purpose: make Inanis PAWN_EVAL_CACHE semantic payload nontrivial while preserving the two material-relation squares
PAWN_CARRIER.construction: add exactly one WHITE pawn and one BLACK pawn to every core material vertex; total 7 pieces

selection.exposure_matching: frozen before intervention; use cross-engine MAIN/QSEARCH hit-density features only in PAWNLESS_CORE

authority_ceiling: relation-conditioned transport within frozen engine/source/resource/world lanes
Inanis channel-specific causal authority only for channels independently admitted in P21
no claim that different persistent-memory channels are homologous merely because effect signs match
no literal sequential intervention-order noncommutativity without sequential operators
no Lc0 causal claim unless one channel is separately prospectively admitted

resource_and_selection_freeze.core_selection_algorithm: Among cells with positive MAIN and QSEARCH SHAM engagement on all three P20-admitted targets, standardize the nine frozen exposure features over all eligible cells; within each material vertex and side select the six smallest squared distances to the global zero/mean exposure point, tie by candidate_sha256.
resource_and_selection_freeze.core_balance_gate: Before any core selective arm, pooled HEAVY_HEAVY vs pooled MINOR_MINOR absolute standardized mean difference must be <=0.50 for every frozen exposure feature. Otherwise EXPOSURE_BALANCE_HOLD and no core intervention.
resource_and_selection_freeze.carrier_eligibility: Positive QSEARCH-TT SHAM hit on each of Stockfish19/Berserk/Ethereal and positive QSEARCH×PAWN_EVAL_CACHE SHAM hit on admitted Inanis.
resource_and_selection_freeze.carrier_selection_algorithm: Within each carrier material vertex and side, select six eligible cells by candidate_sha256 only; heterogeneous channel hit magnitudes are not treated as commensurable.

carrier_scalar_curvature_classification.resolution: 1/n where n=12 committed cells per vertex

resource_and_selection_freeze.broader_qsearch_memory_support_rule: On PAWN_CARRIER HEAVY_HEAVY, admitted Inanis QSEARCH×PAWN_EVAL_CACHE must classify NEGATIVE and at least two of the three admitted QSEARCH×SEARCH_TT targets must also classify NEGATIVE. Sign agreement alone does not establish channel homology.
resource_and_selection_freeze.pawnless_inanis_negative_control: On PAWNLESS_CORE, MASK_PAWN_Q should produce zero fine exact-world changes; any nonzero result blocks interpreting pawn-carrier PAWN_Q transport as semantic-payload evidence.
resource_and_selection_freeze.core_inanis_postselection_gate: After core exposure-balanced selection is frozen, every selected cell must show positive Inanis SHAM TT_MAIN hit and positive PAWN_Q hit; failure is a lane HOLD with no reselection.

final_decision_tree.core_relation_boundary_replicated: Exposure balance gate PASS AND all three P20-admitted engines are CURVED/QSEARCH/-1 on HEAVY_HEAVY AND MINOR_MINOR does not have one common CURVED dominant-coordinate/sign fingerprint across all three.
final_decision_tree.broader_qsearch_memory: SUPPORTED_WITHIN_CARRIER_SCOPE iff pawnless Inanis PAWN_Q negative control has zero fine changes AND PAWN_CARRIER HEAVY_HEAVY is NEGATIVE for Inanis QSEARCH×PAWN_EVAL_CACHE and for at least two of SF19/Berserk/Ethereal QSEARCH×SEARCH_TT.
primary_verdict_order: Else if core relation boundary fails: P20_RELATION_BOUNDARY_NOT_FRESHLY_REPLICATED.
Else if broader_qsearch_memory support rule passes: RELATION_BOUNDARY_REPLICATED_AND_BROADER_QSEARCH_MEMORY_TRANSPORT_SUPPORTED.
Else if at least two TT-qsearch targets are NEGATIVE on carrier but Inanis PAWN_Q is not NEGATIVE: RELATION_BOUNDARY_REPLICATED_TT_QSEARCH_SPECIFIC_WITHIN_TESTED_SCOPE.
